newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan real estate supported by land hopes.
newsitem.headline: Japan real estate supported by land hopes.

text.p: Shares in Japan's real estate sector were firm on Thursday on vague hopes that land liquidity will improve soon, brokers said.
As of 0346 GMT, the sector was at the top of the list of gaining sectors on the Tokyo bourse.
Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd was the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse, with 4.32 million shares traded. The shares were up 60 yen at 1,600.
Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd had added 24 yen to reach 1,020. Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd was up 20 yen at 1,700.
"Foreign investor buying is seen in issues such as Mitsui Fudosan and Sumitomo Reality," a broker at a major brokerage said.
